preferred_style.name: GitHub repo card
preferred_style.description: GitHub repository/PR/issue card on light background with face on right side. Inspired by Nick Saraev (4Cb_l2LJAW8). Uses fake repo names, descriptions, and stats to create curiosity. Face expression is contemplative or surprised — NOT exaggerated/crazy reactions.

global_feedback.facial_expressions: Keep expressions modest and natural — no exaggerated shock/surprise faces. Contemplative, serious, or subtly concerned work best.
global_feedback.hairstyle: Don't make hair too curly — keep it natural to the reference photos.
